description: A register refusal before the first registration is fatal: state error with the code's own TunnelStatusCode and constant lastError (the server message is never shown). USERNAME_REQUIRED, QUOTA_EXCEEDED, CONFLICT and INVALID_NAME (D-2026-10-14-04). After each error the same config starts again.

expect.lastError: Choose a username in your mcpwarp account first.
Your mcpwarp account has no services left in its quota.
The name is in use by another server.
The service name is invalid: use lowercase letters, digits and dashes (not at the start or end), at most 30 characters.
